response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned, versatile software engineer with 15+ years of experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure systems, and some entrepreneurial spirit through his open-source GISCollective project. However, the role requires a Director-level Principal Engineer with recognized AI expertise, demonstrated AI products/platforms, cloud strategy vision, and experience advising strategic customers/partners — none of which is substantiated in this resume. His AI exposure is limited to a few months of MCP/agentic tooling work at his current role, and his career trajectory shows IC-level Senior/Staff titles rather than strategic or director-level scope.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across multiple stacks and domains
Entrepreneurial track record founding and sustaining an open-source geo-data platform (GISCollective) for nearly a decade
Recent direct exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and agentic frameworks (MCP) in current role
concerns: No evidence of director-level strategic leadership, executive influence, or cross-organizational technical vision-setting
AI/ML expertise is minimal and very recent (a few months), not the 'recognized expertise' or demonstrated AI products the role requires
No cloud platform strategy experience or customer/partner advisory experience mentioned anywhere in the resume

key_factors.factor: Lack of recognized AI expertise or demonstrated AI products
No director-level strategic or customer-advisory experience
Broad engineering breadth and entrepreneurial project experience
